conf_d_dir.description: Directory where additional configuration files are located.

flush_lines.description: Number of lines to buffer before flushing.

time_reopen.description: Time in seconds to reopen a file after it was closed due to an error.

log_fifo_size.description: Size of the log output FIFO buffer.

chain_hostnames.description: Chain hostname of the message source.

use_dns.description: Perform DNS lookup on the source IP address.

use_fqdn.description: Use fully qualified domain name for the hostname.

keep_hostname.description: Keep the original hostname from the message.

path_var_log_messages.description: Path to the general messages log file.

path_var_log_secure.description: Path to the security/auth log file.

path_var_log_maillog.description: Path to the mail log file.

mail_flush_lines.description: Number of lines to buffer in the mail destination before flushing.

path_var_log_spooler.description: Path to the spooler log file.

path_var_log_boot_log.description: Path to the boot log file.

path_var_log_cron.description: Path to the cron log file.

path_var_log_kern.description: Path to the kernel log file.

include_conf_d_glob.description: Glob pattern for including additional configuration files.
